latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of mrxlolcat-agent.

- Introduces the master AI automation agent for the Farcaster ecosystem.
- Enables autonomous on-chain actions and cross-chain bridging (via LI.FI) across 60+ blockchains.
- Implements long-term user memory using Pinecone.
- Supports real-time wallet monitoring and Farcaster social interactions.
- Provides micropayment support for paid API access.
- Designed to operate with a cowboy cat persona, prioritizing Base and Optimism networks.
